title: 306 番外一 喜子伯与蛛母305 使命
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：其实说起来，庄宁其心可诛，这声“升帐”
其实是昨晚想听到。
那个时候距离又远，各地行军赶来的各个城防营主帅又劳累，又有怨言，都是粗人，又许多人喝高了。
听了我的话，灵灵她们三个微微一愣，然后看着爷爷，一看之下，发现爷爷正一脸微笑的看着她们，于是脸一红，然后走到爷爷的面前，随即说道：“灵灵，媚儿，彩儿拜见黄老前辈。
祝黄老前辈万寿无疆。
“说完看着爷爷。
从那一天开始，我、胡鑫磊、张宇三人，每天早晨五点提前起床，带着田一飞长跑。
随着178的视线看去，那里是周阳一路来唯一见到的一处空白，没有任何苦力以及金属之地。
走了几步，脚下的石头嘎巴嘎巴的响了几声，立刻听到远处传来说话的声音。
“爷爷，您就这么想看着您的宝贝孙子吃亏吗？”
孙志方疑惑的问道。
“怎么了魅力？”
张岩看见魅力类呆呆的不知道在想什么，问了一句。
奇异画面笼罩四方，如天地纹理形成的墙壁，却又完全不相同，刘枫与张道陵都非常清楚，这是炉内‘丹药’将要出世，这才导致有异象呈现，遍布四方。
沈桐坐下后，刻意往边上坐了坐，而乔曼用手指从上捋了捋散落的头发，把外套脱掉扔到一边，然后又把一步裙褪去，迷迷糊糊地靠在沙发上，对着沈桐傻笑。
“妙，真是妙，节度使大人真不愧是节度使大人，草民自叹不如。”
火野由衷地佩服道。
而就在这个时候，强大的灵力也是在刘齐天的手掌之中汇聚了起来。
“只是你没想到，这两人会有如此大的分歧，甚至拔刀相向？”
李三娘接过话来，反问道。

其中一名黑衣老者缓缓开口，其目光根本没有将宁岳放在眼中，甚至是不屑于正眼看向宁岳，他的目光自出现后便一直盯着那听雨峰，显然他在意的是那正在复活的二人。
“黑洞出现，紫光射下，体内溢出紫光。”
李长老口中喃喃道，同时又有些不敢相信的看向宁岳的额头，一道紫色菱状的印记出现在宁岳的眉心，在看到这一幕之后李长老笑了起来，就如同疯了一般。
“不会的，我就是做了一个噩梦，爸爸早上的时候还和我说话来着，说病好了要带我去看海，你骗人，我不信我要去看爸爸。”
content_en:
: In fact, speaking of it, Zhuang Ning's heart is to be punished, this "raise the account"
Actually I wanted to hear it last night.
At that time, the distance was long, and the commanders of the various city defense battalions who had marched from various places were tired and complaining. They were all rough men, and many of them were drunk.
After hearing my words, Lingling and the other three were slightly startled, and then they looked at grandpa. At first glance, they found that grandpa was looking at them with a smile on his face, so they blushed, then walked up to grandpa, and then said: "Lingling, Mei'er, Cai'er pays homage to Senior Huang.
I wish Mr. Huang a long life.
"After speaking, I looked at Grandpa.
From that day on, Hu Xinlei, Zhang Yu and I got up early at five o'clock every morning and took Tian Yifei for a long run.
Following 178's gaze, it was the only blank space Zhou Yang had seen along the way, without any coolies or metal.
After walking a few steps, the stones under my feet rattled a few times, and I immediately heard voices coming from afar.
"Grandpa, do you really want to see your precious grandson suffer?"
Sun Zhifang asked doubtfully.
"What's wrong Charming?"
Zhang Yan asked when he saw that the charming class was dumbfounded and didn't know what he was thinking.
Strange pictures shrouded the four directions, like walls formed by the texture of heaven and earth, but completely different. Both Liu Feng and Zhang Daoling knew very well that this was the "elixir" in the furnace that was about to be born, which caused strange phenomena to appear and spread all over the place.
After Shen Tong sat down, he deliberately sat on the side, while Qiaoman combed his loose hair with his fingers, took off his coat and threw it aside, then took off his skirt, leaned on the sofa in a daze, and smiled stupidly at Shen Tong.
"Wonderful, really wonderful. Lord Jieduzhi is indeed worthy of being Lord Jiedushi. The ordinary people feel inferior."
Huo Ye said with sincere admiration.
At this moment, powerful spiritual power also gathered in Liu Qitian's palm.
"It's just that you didn't expect that these two people would have such big differences and even draw swords against each other?"
Li Sanniang took the words and asked.
One of the old men in black spoke slowly. His eyes did not pay attention to Ning Yue at all. He even disdained to look at Ning Yue. His eyes had been staring at Ting Yufeng since he appeared. It was obvious that he cared about the two people who were being resurrected.
"The black hole appears, purple light shines down, and purple light overflows from the body."
Elder Li murmured, and at the same time looked at Ning Yue's forehead in disbelief. A purple diamond-shaped mark appeared between Ning Yue's eyebrows. After seeing this scene, Elder Li laughed as if he was crazy.
"No, I just had a nightmare. My father still talked to me in the morning and said that he would take me to see the sea after he recovered. You lied. I don't believe it. I want to see my father."
